acceptable_alternatives: Private tuple/helper value computed only after allowlist or equivalent extraction; no exported abstraction.
mandatory_semantic_checks: All five allowed paths produce same lookup tuple.
Unlisted sibling/extra suffix throws before lookup.
Bundle absent retains resourceNotFound; MIME unchanged.

correct_outcome.outcome: Extract same URL component operations behind exact allowlist and keep call order/error mapping.
correct_outcome.reasoning: Current normalization strips edge slashes and exact set blocks other paths; decomposition via URL operations must remain text-equivalent.

plausible_incorrect_outcome.outcome: Allow prefix Reader.css or derive a filename before validating only the basename.
plausible_incorrect_outcome.reasoning: Unlisted directories/suffixes may now reach bundle lookup, widening input authority beyond behavior preservation.

oracle_validation.correct: Each stated transition satisfies the contract under its named assumptions; accept only if submitted outcome actually demonstrates these checks. This is not validation of an executable patch.
oracle_validation.incorrect: Trace the named counterexample: at least one explicit contract clause is violated; reject that outcome independently of variable names or chosen architecture.

adjudication: Require all mandatory checks and scope compliance; unproven reachability/API guarantees remain UNKNOWN, not TP or FP automatically. A runtime-dependent success gate remains open. Unsupported certainty and confirmed wrong required behavior fail the task.
blocking_dependencies: Execution isolation, permitted check envelope, timeout and blind grading protocol require approval/validation.
